description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_Length`, which represents a measurable CSS length with properties for magnitude, unit, validation, and comparison. It includes methods for creating, validating, and comparing length objects, and references external classes like `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Number` and `HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter`.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Length
classes.description: Represents a CSS length with magnitude and unit, providing validation and comparison functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new length object with given magnitude and unit.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Static factory to parse a string like '2em' into a length object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the length's numeric value and unit.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the length (e.g., '12px').

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the numeric magnitude as a string.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Returns the unit of the length as a string.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the length object is valid.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this length to another, considering unit conversion.
